meta.title: Add tx_index and block_number to dex.trades
meta.body_summary: Add tx_index column to dex.trades and propagate to related models (enrichment macros, OneInch, 0x) to improve efficiency of spells like dex.sandwiches and dex.atomic_arbitrages.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added tx_index column to dex.trades and related models; bot review found no issues; PR closed without merge and no human feedback; no performance evidence provided.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 37 changed lines across 14 files, this is a very small and scattered change typical of a simple column addition. The PR was closed without merge, which is unexpected for such a low-risk change; likely due to missing reviewer attention or submission process issues.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review feedback; only bot review which raised no issues.
review_details.performance_claim: Improves efficiency of related spells like dex.sandwiches and dex.atomic_arbitrages by adding tx_index for accurate transaction ordering on sub-second blocks.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge; no explicit rejection or feedback in review comments.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent correctly added the column across many SQL models; merge failure lies in process (draft → ready-for-review but no maintainer action).

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed changed files and generated no comments; no human maintainer code review occurred.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics for the claimed efficiency gain; only narrative claim in PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression identified; PR closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added tx_index column to dex.trades main model, enrichment macros (enrich_dex_trades, enrich_balancer_v3_dex_trades), and propagated to OneInch and 0x trade models and native fills across chains. Some files also had NULL tx_index placeholder.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changes are small additions of tx_index column; .github/workflows/cla.yml change is unrelated merge artifact.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added tx_index to main dex_trades and enrichment macros.
Second commit: added tx_index with NULL value to 1inch and 0x trade models.
Third commit: propagated tx_index to OneInch and 0x native fills models across Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB, Optimism, Polygon chains.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot reviewed 3 changed files and found no issues.
Multiple workflow runs approved by dune-eng account.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR as draft with initial column addition.
Copilot bot reviewed and found no issues.
Author (0xRobin) merged main, then Cursor added more column additions for chain-specific models.
Author marked PR ready for review but no human reviewer engaged; PR eventually closed without merge.
